evidence: C4 (+5V decoupling) sits far above U2 with a large visible gap and C2 is several mm below-left of U2, so the LDO's caps are not immediately adjacent to its power pins, while C1/C3 do sit tight against U1.

Only 2-pin connectors are present (no relay or ADC pin rows) and the straight pad-to-source lines for J1, J2 and J3 do not cross each other in the 2D view.
Power placement reads left-to-right J1 input -> C1/C3 input caps -> U1 buck -> D1/L1 -> C2 bulk -> U2 LDO -> C5/C6 -> J2/J3 outputs, with bulk capacitors on the input side of each regulator.
